criteria.deficiency: The extra translatePrologue call on q.prologue[0] at algebra.py:753 (before the loop, which already processes it at :757-758) makes the first prologue non-idempotent. A relative PREFIX IRI declared before a BASE in that prologue is resolved against the BASE in the second pass, so e.g. 'PREFIX ex: <rel/> BASE <http://b/> ...' now binds ex to http://b/rel/ instead of the original rel/. This is a narrow regression of existing string-update behavior that the reference does not have. Fix: handle the empty request without a pre-pass (for example, translate the prologue inside the empty-request branch only) so each prologue is applied exactly once.
